disposition_reason: Per-product concentrations (µg/g) of eleven elements in 33 imported dietary supplement tablets bought in Lebanese pharmacies, with category and overall means in the text.

study.design: Market survey of imported dietary supplement tablets (3 vitamin, 13 vitamin and mineral, 7 mineral, 10 herbal)
study.origin: Manufactured in Italy, USA, Belgium, UK, Denmark, Switzerland, Canada (Table 1)
study.method: Handheld EDXRF for Ca, Cu, Fe, Mn, Se, Zn; H2O2/HNO3 (or aqua regia) digestion then GF-AAS for Cd, Cr, Mo, Pb and ICP-MS for As, Hg
study.lod_text: Instrument detection limits: Cd 2 µg/L, Cr 4 µg/L, Pb 3 µg/L, Mo 30 µg/L (GF-AAS); Hg 50 ppt, As 25 ppt (ICP-MS)
study.qa: NIST 1573a tomato leaves and NIST 2586 soil in triplicate; XRF recoveries 88-101%, digestion recoveries 89-101% (Tables 5-6)
